w: A program by children on Bal Din was presented in the evening assembly. On the principal theme of 'Mare Swamine Raji Karavaj Chhe' the balaks conducted a bal sabha, a question answer session with Swamishri and a few skits showing the importance of moral and spiritual values given by Satsang. Swamishri finally blessed the assembly, saying, "Your parents have gone through a lot of struggle and pain in raising you. Likewise you should attend to them and bear any struggle or discomfort for them. They have tolerated your nature when you were young, and now you too should bear with theirs. To tolerate mutually is a hallmark of our culture and a part of family feelings."

w: At 10.15 a.m., Swamishri visited the BAPS 'Swaminarayan Vidyapith' - an English medium residential school for girls. Swamishri sanctified the prayer hall of the hostel and performed pujan and arti of the murtis installed there. He also inaugurated the dining hall and visited the computer center, kitchen and school grounds. The girls were sitting afar according to the Swaminarayan disciplines.

In the evening, Swamishri delivered his blessings through video conferencing in the concluding plenary session of the 3-day Global Religious Conference at the Raritan center, Edison, USA. More than 2,000 Hindu students from 50 countries were attending the conference. After President Abdul Kalam's video conferencing address, Swamishri delivered his 20-minutes blessings that was translated into English. Swamishri said, "... Just as we take care of and utilize the money we get and the land we acquire, we should also care for our heritage and Dharma. And this is possible only if we have good character and perform good actions. Dharma is a matter of imbibing and not of offering lip-service. One can only experience the taste of food by eating it. Similarly, if one talks about dharma, listens about dharma and reads about dharma one cannot experience its benefits till it is put into action ..." ( See News report )
A person progresses in life through good actions. (19 July 2003, Anand)
We are valued by our character, culture and dharma. (19 July 2003, Anand)
The elements that destroy unity and friendship are that 'I know everything and others don't. (19 July 2003, Anand)
When there is unity and friendship in Satsang, family and friends then one will have peace, happiness and progress. (19 July 2003, Anand)

To please Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Guru Pramukh Swami Maharaj children, youths and senior devotees perform austerities, pilgrimages or other devotional means. The spiritual endeavors performed by the devotees during Swamishri's visit to the local centers are congratulatory and worthy of recognition. It also reflects Swamishri's divinity for inspiring such spiritual efforts in children, teenagers and devotees.
16 July 2003, Bochasan
To please Swamishri 102 satsangi youths prostrated 6 km from Borsad. Forty-five satsangi women pilgrimaged by foot from Borsad.
26 July 2003, Vidyanagar

Swamishri blessed 135 APC (hostel) students for observing penance as part of Shravan month: 110 students performed dharna-parna for 15 days, 20 students were on liquid only and 8 students performed strict (paka) dharna-parna.

Karyakar Din In today's Karyakar Din, all karyakars received special guidance from senior sadhus on how to improve their seva. Sadhus also explained the importance of seva and bhakti through various kirtans.

Standing before the murtis of Thakorji in the main mandir, Swamishri addressed a group of youths from England and America who had been travelling with him, “You all live abroad but ensure that you observe dharma properly. Serve your parents dutifully. Also study well and practice satsang sincerely. Concentrate on your studies. Keep satsang at the forefront of your lives. Perform daily puja and observe niyams. Be careful you do not become lax in satsang. Also encourage others to come to satsang.”
After this, the youngsters arranged themselves around Swamishri for a group photo.
Swamishri asked, “Where have you stored this photo?”
One youth said, “Over there.”
“Where?” Swamishri asked
“In our hearts,” another youth replied.
The first youth asked, “If such a photo is taken will we get visas to go directly to Akshardham?”
Swamishri said, “If you observe Maharaj’s commands properly, you will get visas to go directly to Akshardham.”

ds.t: "Only if you study do you have a life"
w: Wednesday, 27 July 2005 (Ashadh vad 7, Samvat 2061), Bochasan
During the meetings, a devotee from abroad had brought his son to India specially to study. Pramukh Swami Maharaj asked, "What is the reason for having him study here?"
"There he has gone off on the wrong track. He tells me, 'Let me turn eighteen. When I turn eighteen, I will marry some American girl.'"

Seeing this tendency in him already, Swamishri immediately said, "Hey, you will find plenty of girls later. If you study well, they will come to you of their own accord. So first finish your studies. If you study, you will also have respect in society. And give up such wrong ways, and if you have addictions or vices, give those up too. Only if you study do you have a life. Otherwise, without respect, no one will even give you their daughter. If your respect is lost, who will give you one? So do not think such thoughts from now, do not go wandering about, and do not fall into addictions either. Pay attention to your studies. Only then will your future be good. You will be able to serve your parents, God and society too. If you study, you will also get good money and everything else. So give up this tendency." Swamishri explained to him lovingly.

At 10.09 am Swamishri departed from Toronto International Airport and landed at Morristown airport in New Jersey at 11.05 am. Swamishri arrived at the mandir to a tumultuous welcome from devotees, youths and children. In the evening Swamishri started another round of EECP treatment.

Pratikbhai phoned from America. He follows the 'Hare Krishna' organisation in his devotion, but has deep reverence for Pramukh Swami Maharaj. He wished to receive Swamishri's blessings that devotion would become even firmer in his life. Swamishri began to give blessings and he was overcome with emotion and began to cry. Receiving the blessings of a Satpurush like Swamishri, his heart overflowed. Blessing him, Swamishri said, "You have feeling and you do devotion, and I have prayed that you may do even better devotion. You have my blessings."

Pratikbhai phoned from America. He follows the Hare Krishna organisation in his devotion, but he has reverence for Pramukh Swami Maharaj. His wish was to receive Swamishri's blessings so that devotion would become even firmer in his life. Swamishri began to bless him, and he was overcome with emotion and began to cry. His heart overflowed on receiving the blessings of a Satpurush like Swamishri. Blessing him, Swamishri said, "You have feeling and you do devotion, and I have prayed that you can do even better devotion. You have my blessings."

In the evening, Mahant Swami Maharaj left the mandir to go to Niagara Falls to immerse the ashes of Pramukh Swami Maharaj. Gunsagardas Swami said, "Earlier there was a forecast of 80 percent rain. Now we request you to send this thunderstorm (rain with a storm) somewhere else."
Swamishri said, "It has not gone elsewhere; it has gone up. If it went elsewhere it would cause trouble there. This thunderstorm was going to come, but now it has turned away."
Shrutipriyadas Swami said, "Now the forecast of rain there has become zero percent."
Swamishri did some reading for a while. Then talk of the rain came up again, because heavy rain was falling on the road.
The sadhus asked, "Swami! What if it rains at Niagara right during our ceremony?!"
Swamishri said, "It will not."
Swamishri said this as naturally as we would take responsibility for switching off a fan.

After a while, talk of rain came up yet again. This time Swamishri himself asked, "It is raining all along the way, so is it not raining there?" The attendant sadhus immediately phoned. In the meantime Swamishri began to reason, "With this much rain here on the way, there should be rain there." But truly, just as Swamishri had blessed, there was no rain there.
Swamishri said, "Once our work is done, let whatever happen." And he also said, "After we leave, it will pour."
Some time passed, and a call came from there: "Now the whole sky is turning black. It looks like rain and it is very likely to rain." This time Swamishri said emphatically, "It definitely will not."

At 6.45, Swamishri arrived at Burch's Mill Landmark Park near Niagara Falls. After Swamishri's blessings, the sadhus performed the pujan of the urn of ashes with Vedic rites. Throughout this ceremony one could see that the atmosphere had become completely rainy. It seemed the rain would fall at any moment, and that a torrent like the flow of the Niagara River would begin to flow on this land too, but all of it was being held back; only a few drops fell now and then. There was fear, of course, but there was also faith that Swamishri's words would not prove false.
As soon as Swamishri set foot in the car to leave, the rain started on this side. Shrutipriyadas Swami said, "Swami! You had said that after we left it would pour. That is exactly what happened."
Swamishri said, "I was turning the mala so that it would not rain."
As Mahant Swami Maharaj was returning from Niagara Falls, the driver, Mukeshbhai, said, "In just a few days you have given everyone great happiness."
Swamishri said with feeling, "The supply comes directly from Maharaj and Swami."
It was as if Swamishri had revealed his own form while speaking of it as if of another.
